entities.summary: Johann Olav Koss is a former speed skater from Norway. He won four Olympic gold medals, including three at the 1994 Winter Olympics in his home country. Johann Olav Koss was a physicians & medical pioneers from Drammen (b. 1968-10-29, Drammen). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
